Chiar dacă drona înarmată cu explozibil găsită miercuri pe aeroportul din Leipzig nu a explodat, faptul că …

latvia.title: Zelenskõi ja Läti välisminister arutasid Ukrainale antavaid toetus
latvia.description: Ukraina president Volodõmõr Zelenskõi arutas kolmapäeval kohtumisel Läti välisministri Baiba Bražega toetust Ukraina Euroopa integratsioonile, nelja täiendava läbirääkimisvaldkonna avamist Euroopa Liiduga ning programmide PURL ja SAFE elluviimist.

latvia.title: Ukraina registreeris juulis üle pika aja suurima tsiviilohvrite arvu
latvia.description: Juulis oli Ukrainas alates 2022. aasta aprillist suurim tsiviilohvrite arv Venemaa rünnakute intensiivistumise tõttu, milles kasutati ballistilisi rakette ja kaugmaadroone, edastas neljapäeval uudisteagentuur Ukrinform.

latvia.title: Politico: USA ja Ukraina luurealased suhted on jõudsalt paranenud
latvia.description: Ühendriikide ja Ukraina vahelised luureandmete jagamise suhted on alates 2025. aasta märtsist märkimisväärselt paranenud, kirjutas kolmapäeval USA mõjukas poliitikaväljaanne Politico, mida vahendas uudisteagentuur Unian.

latvia.title: Stubbi sõnul vajab Ukraina õhutõrjesüsteemi tugevdamist
latvia.description: Soome president Alexander Stubb teatas kolmapäeval, et rääkis Ukraina presidendi Volodõmõr Zelenskõiga ja Ukraina vajab hädasti õhutõrjesüsteemi tugevdamist, edastasid uudisteagentuurid STT ja Ukrinform.

latvia.title: BLOGI ⟩ 1625. sõjapäev Ukrainas: Rootsi annab Venemaa varilaevastiku aluse Ukrainale üle
latvia.description: 2022. aasta 24. veebruaril alustas Venemaa režiimi juht Vladimir Putin sissetungi Ukrainasse. Pärast seda, kui Ukraina lõi tagasi pealetungi Kiievile, on lahingute kese kandunud Ida- ja Lõuna-Ukrainasse. Postimees kajastab 1625. sõjapäeva sündmusi allolevas blogis.2026/ukraina-kalender

latvia.title: Rootsi annab Venemaa varilaevastiku aluse Ukrainale üle
latvia.description: Rootsi kohus otsustas kolmapäeval Ukrainale üle anda Venemaa niinimetatud varilaevastiku aluse Caffa, mis Ukraina uurimise andmetel vedas okupeeritud Sevastopolist ebaseaduslikult välja vilja.

latvia.title: POSTIMEES UKRAINAS ⟩ Madjar: Krimmi blokeerimine alles algas, käib esimene etapp
latvia.description: Krimmi poolsaare blokeerimine on alles algusjärgus, ütles intervjuus Postimehele Ukraina droonivägede juht Robert Brovdi, kes on tuntud kui Madjar.

latvia.title: Flora seisab euromängu eel silmitsi paari tähtsa küsimärgiga
latvia.description: Tallinna FC Flora alustab neljapäeval Konverentsiliiga kolmandat eelringi, kui kohtub võõrsil Andorra klubi Escaldese Interiga. Flora peatreeneri Konstantin Vassiljevi hinnangul on võtmetähtsusega keskendumine.

latvia.title: Frosty meeting between Latvian government and NGOs
latvia.description: A meeting between Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List) and non-governmental organizations (NGOs) was not a constructive dialogue, according to representatives of the organizations. The government will continue to criticize NGO funding.

latvia.title: Now Rīga Airport border control experiences 'technical issues'
latvia.description: Following days of delays at the Latvia-Belarus border due to IT system glitches, on Wednesday, August 5th it was the turn of Riga Airport to experience "technical issues".

latvia.title: Monthly fuel prices down 3.5% in Latvia
latvia.description: The data from the Central Statistical Bureau (CSB), published on August 5, show that in July 2026, compared to June 2026, the average level of consumer prices of fuels for transport decreased by 3.5 %.

latvia.title: Conscripts might be sent to patrol Latvia's eastern border in future
latvia.description: The situation on the Latvian-Belarusian border has become serious, and the State Border Guard needs additional human resources to guard it, Deputy Chief of the State Border Guard, General Juris Martukāns, said on the Latvian Radio programme "Krustpunktā" (At the crossroads) on August 5th.

latvia.title: Tobacco use still pretty popular in Latvia
latvia.description: In 2025, 16.5% of people 16 years or older in the EU used tobacco and related products (e-cigarettes, nicotine pouches or heated tobacco products) daily, indicating a slight decrease from the 17.5% registered in 2022. Most people (77.5%) do not use such products or had not used them in the 12 months prior to the data collection.

latvia.title: Moscow-based Latvian scammer group detained
latvia.description: On 3 August this year, the State Police’s Cybercrime Combating Administration concluded their investigation into the activities of an organised criminal group – phone scammers who, whilst based in Moscow, Russia, defrauded several Latvian residents between May and September 2025, police said.

latvia.title: Anti-mobility drills to take place in Rīga on Friday
latvia.description: On Friday, 7 August, a practical exercise will take place on Ojāra Vācieša Street in Rīga, during which Rīga City Council, together with its partners, will construct anti-mobility engineering structures – physical barriers designed to slow the movement of enemy forces in an urban environment, the city council said.

latvia.title: Urgent repairs required at Balvi swimming pool
latvia.description: The Balvi municipality urgently needs to find at least 80,000 euros to repair the local swimming pool.

latvia.title: Latvian government hopes to close business address loophole
latvia.description: At the Cabinet meeting on August 4th, Minister of Justice Edvards Smiltēns raised a significant problem: the dishonest registration of legal addresses of businesses on property owned by another person without the knowledge and consent of the owner of that property.

latvia.title: Blood donors urged to come forward in Latvia
latvia.description: Donor activity traditionally declines in the summer but at the same time, the number of injuries rises, planned and emergency operations take place, and the treatment of cancer and other patients continues – all of which require blood every single day. The State Blood Donor Centre is urging potential donors to come donate.

latvia.title: Latvian Minister in the soup after lecturing Spain on immigration
latvia.description: Latvian Interior Minister Jānis Dombrava (National Alliance) appears to have annoyed key EU and NATO partner Spain, reports Latvian Television.

latvia.title: Extortion case goes to prosecution in Latgale, Latvia
latvia.description: The State Police in Latgale are recommending that four people be charged with extortion and other serious crimes in Kārsava, Ludza municipality, police said on August 5.

latvia.title: Hot Wednesday ahead in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that the weather in Latvia will become hotter on Wednesday, according to weatherman Toms Bricis.

latvia.title: Latvian State Security Service looks at violent AI video
latvia.description: The State Security Service is investigating a video of boxer Kristaps Zutis, published on the ‘X’ platform, which was created using artificial intelligence. It shows scenes of violence against third-country citizens, including crude and cruel treatment of food delivery workers.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 4th August, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Latvia's 'national position' on Russia and Belarus is to step up sanctions
latvia.description: On 4th August, the Latvian cabinet approved what it dubbed the country's "national position" with regard to aggressor states Russia and Belarus.

latvia.title: Latvia-Belarus border will not be closed completely
latvia.description: The Latvian-Belarusian border will not be closed for the time being, the government decided on Tuesday, 4 August, during a closed-door meeting, Latvian Radio reported.

latvia.title: Six-year-old missing from Rīga found
latvia.description: The State Police reported Tuesday evening that six-year-old Daniels Volkovs, who had gone missing, had been found.

latvia.title: Millions invested in digitalisation, but is productivity keeping pace?
latvia.description: According to the European Commission, Latvia ranks fourth among EU Member States in the digitalisation of public services.

latvia.title: Latvian industry ticked up in June
latvia.description: Central Statistical Bureau calendar adjusted data (at constant prices) published on August 4th show that in June 2026 industrial production output in Latvia increased by 0.5 % year on year.

latvia.title: Tere, naaber! Estonian Days are coming to northern Latvia
latvia.description: Later this month, Latvia's northern Valmiera region will be extending a warm welcome to visitors from even further north with the first ever 'Estonian Days' due to take place.

latvia.title: Street in Rīga closed due to dilapidated building
latvia.description: To prevent any potential risk to public safety, vehicle traffic has been closed and pedestrian access restricted from 3 August at the unoccupied building at 8 Daugavpils Street, Rīga,

latvia.title: It's fine to swim in Saldus Lake again
latvia.description: The Health Inspectorate has lifted the advice against swimming in Lake Saldus, the Inspectorate said on 4 August.

latvia.title: Latvian public media watchdog head re-elected
latvia.description: Sanita Upleja-Jegermane has been reappointed as chair of the Public Electronic Mass Media Council (SEPLP) for the next term, running from 4 August 2026 to 3 August 2027, the SEPLP announced.

latvia.title: Hockey coach in custody for alleged sexual abuse of minor
latvia.description: A coach at the “Ogres novada Lāči” children’s and youth ice hockey club has been arrested on suspicion of sexual abuse of a child during a camp, the State Police reported on August 4. Police are calling on other potential victims to come forward.

latvia.title: Estonian border guards head south to help Latvia
latvia.description: The Estonian Police and Border Guard Board (PPA) sent a third rotating unit to Latvia on Monday, August 3rd to help stop illegal migration on the Latvian-Belarusian border, reports ERR News.

latvia.title: Rīga bars try out new dating app
latvia.description: Eight bars in the Latvian capital Rīga, are trialling a new social interaction or dating app, reports Labs of Latvia.

latvia.title: Latvia is in a strong position on water resources
latvia.description: Latvia's many lakes and rivers give it a strong portfolio of freshwater 'water resources' – an increasingly important thing in a drier, hotter world – according to latest Eurostat data.

latvia.title: Trash will be costlier in Liepāja and southwestern Latvia
latvia.description: In the South Kurzeme region and in Liepāja, household waste collection charges are set to rise twice this year, Latvian Radio reported on August 4.

latvia.title: Closure of Latvia-Belarus border point proposed
latvia.description: The Ministry of the Interior will ask the government to suspend operations at the ‘Pāternieki’ border crossing between Latvia and Belarus, according to a publicly available draft government decision from the ministry on August 3.

latvia.title: Possible Livonian castle site examined by archaeologists
latvia.description: The largest archaeological excavations to date are taking place at Grebu Hill Fort and the adjacent Grebu Bļodas Hill in Dikļu Parish, Valmiera Municipality. The first pottery shards have been found, and researchers hope to find the answer to a centuries-old question – whether this could be the site of the Livonian Metsepole Castle mentioned in written sources, Latvian Television reported on August 4.

latvia.title: Vītoliņš remains head coach of Latvia's national men's hockey team
latvia.description: The Latvian Ice Hockey Federation (LHF) has agreed with Harijs Vītoliņš, head coach of the men’s national ice hockey team, to continue their collaboration for another season, the LHF announced on Monday, August 3.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 3rd August, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: airBaltic bondholder meeting fails to get off the ground
latvia.description: A meeting that was supposed to take place on Monday, August 3rd to decide the financial future of Latvian national airline airBaltic had to be postponed because not enough of the company's bondholders registered to attend it.

latvia.title: Number of burglaries dramatically down over the decade in Latvia
latvia.description: As summer holidays begin, police across the European Union are urging residents to take extra care to protect their homes against burglaries and break-ins.

latvia.title: Woman in Mārupe, Latvia accused of attempted murder of family
latvia.description: The State Police are requesting that a woman born in 1981 be charged with the attempted murder of two people – evidence gathered during the investigation suggests that on 8 December last year she poisoned her son and common-law husband with medication. The woman has been arrested, police said on August 3.

latvia.title: Latvia has 334 thousand children
latvia.description: According to the Central Statistical Bureau data published on August 3, inhabitants aged 17 and under totalled 334 thousand at the beginning of 2026, accounting for 18.1 % of the country’s population.

latvia.title: Trucks stuck at Latvia-Belarus border
latvia.description: The “Pāternieki” border crossing with Belarus remains closed. It was closed due to technical faults in the information systems. Over the weekend, several lorry drivers were stranded there, unable to process their documents, Latvian Radio reported on August 3.

latvia.title: Top tick myths busted by Latvian researcher
latvia.description: In the summer, along with going outdoors, concerns about ticks increase. But alongside the real risks, many myths are still prevalent – ​​both about where ticks are found and what to do after being bitten. Do ticks really fall from trees, and are they found on every city lawn?

latvia.title: Another attempt required to find Latvia's senior civil servant
latvia.description: A repeat competition will be required for the position of Director of the State Chancellery, Elīna Šverna, communications advisor to Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List), told the LETA newswire.

latvia.title: Temperatures will rise midweek in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasters predict that air temperatures in Latvia will rise in the middle of this week and fall slightly towards the end of the week.

latvia.title: Kulbergs' claims about NGO costs are questionable
latvia.description: Does each meeting between the government and Non-Governmental Organizations (NGOs) really cost 18,000 euros, as Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs claims? The Re:Check fact-checking strand investigates.

latvia.title: Employee housing considered by some Latvian businesses
latvia.description: This week, the new “Balticovo” rental apartment block for staff will be officially opened in Iecava. The company has invested more than two million euros in its construction. The new building will help tackle the housing problem, which poses challenges for many employers, Latvian Radio reported on August 3.

latvia.title: Latvian duo win Brazilian beach volleyball tournament
latvia.description: Latvian men's beach volleyball duo Mārtiņš Pļaviņš and Kristians Fokerots won the final of the professional tour "Elite 16" level tournament in Brazil on Sunday, claiming gold medals in Rio de Janeiro.

latvia.title: Smiltene church clock is back on time
latvia.description: In recent years, the Smiltene Evangelical Lutheran Church, which dominates the centre of the city, has undergone significant renovation work – the roof has been replaced, the ceiling and historic wall paintings have been restored.

latvia.title: Rēzekne's police keep an eye on illegal fishing
latvia.description: It has been a year since the Rēzekne District Municipal Police, alongside their public order duties, began carrying out regular patrols of public water bodies. More than 35 illegal fishing devices have been seized this year, confirming that illegal fishing remains a pressing issue in the region, Latvian Radio reported on August 3.

latvia.title: Latvian scientist team heads to Greenland
latvia.description: Scientists from the University of Latvia (LU) have travelled to the world’s largest island to continue their research on the glaciers there, which will help to refine forecasts of sea-level rise, Latvian Television reported on August 2.

latvia.title: Latvian watermelons will start to go on sale soon
latvia.description: Weather conditions this summer have been more favourable for the watermelon harvest, but plant diseases continue to pose challenges. Some growers are already starting to sell local watermelons and say that prices will remain unchanged this year, Latvian Radio reported on August 2.

latvia.title: Sunny and warm day in Latvia Monday
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that the weather in Latvia on Monday will be mostly sunny and warm.

latvia.description: Daudzi domā, ka sākumskolas matemātika ir tīrais sīkums – saskaitīt ābolus, atcerēties reizrēķinu, varbūt aprēķināt taisnstūra perimetru… Cik gan grūti tas varētu būt, vai ne? Te ir tava iespēja to pārbaudīt. Vai vari pārspēt deviņgadnieku jeb 3. klases skolēnu matemātikā?

latvia.title: “Tas varbūt izklausās absurdi…” Radusies jauna ideja, kā hakerus izmantot valsts labā
latvia.description: Ideja par tā dēvēto balto hakeru iesaistīšanu valsts kritiskās infrastruktūras aizsardzībā varētu palīdzēt laikus atklāt sistēmu ievainojamības, pirms tās savā labā izmanto ļaunprātīgi hakeri. TV24 raidījumā “Preses klubs” šādu pieeju vērtēja zvērināts advokāts Olavs Cers. Skaidrojot, kā šāda sistēma varētu darboties, Cers vilka paralēles ar medikamentu izstrādi. Pirms jaunas zāles tiek sertificētas un nonāk apritē, […]

latvia.title: VIDEO. Ciemiņi no Transilvānijas? Bēniņos uzstādīta kamera fiksē neparastus apakšīrniekus
latvia.description: Dzirdot dīvainus trokšņus savā mājoklī, ikviens no mums vispirms cenšas noskaidrot to cēloni. Kāds vietnes “Threads” lietotājs izdzirdējis nepazīstamas un neierastas skaņas nākam no bēniņiem, tāpēc nolēma tur uzstādīt novērošanas kameru. Iegūtais video ātri vien atklāja noslēpumaino trokšņotāju personību – tie izrādījās sikspārņi. “Dīvainas skaņas nāca no bēniņiem. Uzliku kameru. Izskatās pēc ciemiņiem no Transilvānijas…” […]

latvia.title: Rīsu ūdens – mārketinga triks vai apstiprināta ķīmija: kāpēc korejietes izskatās tik satriecoši labi?
latvia.description: Tradīcija mazgāt seju ar rīsu ūdeni Āzijā pastāv jau gadsimtiem ilgi, bet pēdējos gados tā piedzīvojusi jaunu popularitātes vilni, pateicoties skaistumkopšanas blogeriem un sociālajiem tīkliem. Par šo seno rituālu raksta izdevums “Space Daily”. Lai gan rīsu ūdens bieži tiek saistīts ar korejiešu sieviešu skaistuma kopšanas tradīcijām, šī prakse nav tikai Korejas kultūras daļa. Līdzīgi rituāli […]

lithuania.title: Elnyerte a demokraták szenátorjelöltségét a muszlim, egyiptomi gyökerű Abdul El-Sayed
lithuania.description: Az orvos végzettségű 44 éves jelölt lehet az Egyesült Államok első muszlim vallású szenátora, ha győz a novemberi félidős választáson.

lithuania.title: Nyolc ember halt meg orosz rakétáktól a vasúti peronon Kijev közelében
lithuania.description: Az áldozatok éppen lekésték az utolsó vonatot, amikor a rakétabecsapódás elérte a peront. A Kijev térségét ért éjszakai támadásban összesen 17 ember halt meg.

lithuania.title: Rémálom a repülőn: 90 métert zuhant a levegőben egy indiai utasszállító
lithuania.description: Legalább 12-en megsérültek, az utastérben burkolati elemek szakadtak le, kitört a pánik. A rémület utáni pillanatokról videó is készült.

lithuania.title: Hitványság, alávaló, közgyalázat – Puzsér Róbert bocsánatot kért a nERDŐ című „kulturális merényletért”
lithuania.description: Puzsér Róbert értékelése szerint a sorozat a South Parkhoz foghatónak hirdette magát, de még Maksa Zoltán humorát is alulmúlta.

lithuania.title: „Mondtam a miniszternek, hogy ugyanilyen gőzössel jártam annak idején dolgozni”
lithuania.description: Három év szünet után újra járnak személyvonatok Komlóra, pedig a város polgármestere korábban a vasútvonal városon belüli szakaszának elbontásáért lobbizott. Bár Vitézy Dávid szimbolikus projektként kezeli az újranyitást, Polics József nem tett le a vasútmentes belvárosról.

lithuania.title: Összeesküvést gyanít Zelenszkij: szövetkeztek Ukrajna ellen a NATO tagállamai?
lithuania.description: Elképzelhető, hogy Ukrajna szövetségesei nyomást akarnak gyakorolni Kijevre azzal, hogy szándékosan nem szállítanak több légvédelmi rakétát - mondta Volodimir Zelenszkij ukrán elnök az Ukrinform cikke szerint.

lithuania.title: Súlyos incidens történt egy NATO-bázison: hajszál híján múlt a katasztrófa, ez akár szándékos támadás is lehet
lithuania.description: A lipcsei repülőtéren kedden késő este talált drón robbanószerkezettel volt felszerelve - közölték a német nyomozóhatóságok.

lithuania.title: Bemondták az oroszok: eljött az idő – Szét kell bombázni Zatokát
lithuania.description: Az ukrán légvédelmi rendszerek kifogytak a rakétákból, meg kell ragadni az alkalmat arra, hogy az orosz haderő mélységi csapásokkal pusztítsa el az Ukrajna és NATO-országok közti logisztikai útvonalakat – mondta Jurij Knutov orosz biztonságpolitikai szakértő az MK -nak.

lithuania.title: Zelenskyj varuje pred kritickým nedostatkom rakiet. NATO musí prelomiť byrokraciu a konať rýchlejšie
lithuania.description: Zelenskyj naliehavo žiada NATO o ďalšie rakety protivzdušnej obrany, kým Rusko stupňuje útoky dronmi a raketami a Kyjev zápasí s kritickým nedostatkom munície.

lithuania.title: Musíme budovat to, k čemu jsme se v NATO zavázali, říká šéf Velitelství pro operace
lithuania.description: „Musím uvést, že my jsme (Severoatlantická) aliance. To není, že nám NATO něco diktuje. My jako Česká republika jsme Aliance a musíme budovat schopnosti, ke kterým jsme se zavázali,“ sdělil v Interview ČT24 moderovaném Danielem Takáčem generálmajor Jaroslav Míka, který je od srpna novým šéfem Velitelství pro operace. Česká armáda má být podle Míky více doma než v zahraničí. „A ona také více doma je. Když se budeme kvantitativně bavit o počtech vojáků, které máme venku, tak politický mandát je zhruba dva tisíce vojáků, přičemž v současné době to číslo osciluje mezi pěti sty a sedmi sty vojáky. To záleží, jestli probíhá nějaká rotace. Takže je zcela zřejmé, že většina armády je doma a připravuje se na obranu České republiky,“ zdůraznil generálmajor, který v rozhovoru mluvil také o náboru vojáků či o situaci na Ukrajině.

lithuania.title: Ukrajina se k NATO nikdy nepřipojí. Aliance je zastaralá, uvedl generál Zalužnyj
lithuania.description: Ukrajina, která od února 2022 bojuje proti ruské invazi a už řadu let usiluje o členství v NATO, se k této alianci nikdy nepřipojí. Podle agentury AFP to v Kyjevě prohlásil bývalý hlavní velitel ukrajinských ozbrojených sil a současný velvyslanec v Británii Valerij Zalužnyj. Zdůvodnil to tím, že Aliance lpí na postupech z druhé světové války a není připravená na konflikty 21. století, což je v kontrastu s ukrajinskou armádou získávající zkušenosti ze současného konfliktu.

lithuania.title: Volodimir Zelenski, discuție cu șeful NATO. Despre ce au vorbit cei doi lideri: „Este bine informat cu privire la amenințări”
lithuania.description: Președintele ucrainean Volodimir Zelenski a declarat miercuri că a discutat cu secretarul general al NATO, Mark Rutte, despre posibilitatea de a obține mai multe rachete de interceptare pentru apărarea aeriană, relatează Reuters.

lithuania.title: Al treilea tunel folosit de migranți descoperit la granița dintre Lituania și Belarus
lithuania.description: Lituania a descoperit un nou tunel, al treilea identificat recent, prin care migranţii urmau să fie introduşi ilegal în această ţară dinspre Belarus, au anunţat miercuri autorităţile de la Vilnius, informează Agerpres, care citează dpa.

lithuania.title: Spania se teme pentru exclavele Ceuta și Melilla. Cine ar sări în ajutorul Madridului în cazul unei acțiuni a Marocului
lithuania.description: Valul de migranți care a ajuns în exclavele spaniole Ceuta și Melilla a reaprins temerile Madridului privind securitatea teritoriilor sale din Africa de Nord. În contextul în care Marocul își intensifică revendicările asupra celor două orașe autonome, oficialii spanioli se întreabă cât de solid ar fi sprijinul aliaților din NATO și al Statelor Unite în cazul unei escaladări a tensiunilor, arată Politico, într-o analiză.

lithuania.title: Incident de securitate: o dronă a zburat în apropierea unui avion ucrainean pe aeroportul din Leipzig/Halle
lithuania.description: La scurt timp după miezul nopții, o alertă de securitate a fost declanșată pe aeroportul Leipzig/Halle. O dronă fusese observată în incintă. Mai multe detalii au apărut acum: potrivit unui purtător de cuvânt al NATO, o dronă a fost observată în apropierea unei aeronave ucrainene, relatează focus.de.

lithuania.title: Ucraina așteaptă undă verde din partea SUA pentru producția rachetelor Patriot. Washingtonul ezită
lithuania.description: Rafalele de rachete balistice lansate de Rusia au determinat Kievul să încerce cu disperare să înceapă producția propriilor rachete de interceptare Patriot, însă, în ciuda acordului inițial al lui Trump pentru o licență de producție, SUA nu au oferit încă nicio certitudine. Este puțin probabil ca Statele Unite să ajungă la un acord cu Ucraina privind producția comună de rachete de interceptare Patriot înainte de această iarnă, a declarat luni ambasadorul SUA la NATO, Matthew Whitaker, alimentând incertitudinea cu privire la cel mai critic aspect al apărării aeriene a Kievului, arată Euronews.

lithuania.title: Noul Comandant-șef al Armatei ucrainene solicită demiterea comandantului Forțelor Medicale. „Omul lui Sîrskîi”
lithuania.description: Noul Comandant-șef al Armatei Ucrainei, Mihailo Drapatîi, a înaintat o cerere prin care solicită demiterea lui Anatolii Kazmirchuk, comandantul Forțelor Medicale.

lithuania.title: Abrudean, apel către senatori: De votul pe legea integrității și strategia pentru biodiversitate depind 3,48 miliarde de euro din PNRR
lithuania.description: Președintele Senatului Mircea Abrudean le cere senatorilor să adopte în această săptămână proiectele privind strategia națională pentru biodiversitate și legea integrității. Liberalul avertizează că de îndeplinirea acestor jaloane din Planul Național de Redresare și Reziliență (PNRR) depinde accesarea a aproximativ 3,48 miliarde de euro.

lithuania.title: Consilierul pe securitate națională de la Cotroceni și șeful Armatei au fost primiți la Pentagon. Mesaj privind NATO 3.0
lithuania.description: Subsecretarul de stat de la Departamentul de Război al Statelor Unite, Elbridge Colby, a anunțat marți că a avut o întrevedere la Pentagon cu consilierul pentru securitate națională de la Cotroceni, Marius Lazurca, căruia i-a prezentat în avans abordarea SUA privind „Europe Posture Review”. La întrunire a participat și șeful Armatei României, generalul Gheorghiță Vlad.

lithuania.title: Tanczos Barna: S-a format o majoritate ciudată pentru legea ANI. E inadmisibil să facem amendamente cu țintă la o persoană
lithuania.description: Legea ANI, adoptată luni de Camera Deputaţilor şi aflată pe ordinea de zi a sesiunea extraordinare a Senatului, care e Cameră decizională, a devenit „un concurs de mesaje politice şi mai puţin un act de legiferare bine gândit”, a declarat marți, la RFI, vicepremierul Tanczos Barna. „E inadmisibil să facem legi pe persoane fizice”, mai declară senatorul UDMR.

lithuania.title: Un pilot ucrainean a urmărit racheta rusească de tip KH-101 care a explodat în Polonia. De ce nu a doborât-o
lithuania.description: Un pilot al Forțelor Aeriene Ucrainene, care se afla în „urmărire directă” a unei rachete rusești de tip Kh-101 care s-a prăbușit în Polonia în luna iulie, a fost nevoit să se întoarcă la graniță din cauza procedurilor NATO, a dezvăluit viceministrul polonez al Apărării, relatează TVPWorld.

lithuania.title: Cum explică Cosmin Marinescu, viceguvernator al BNR, reconfirmarea ratingului României de către Fitch
lithuania.description: Viceguvernatorul BNR Cosmin Marinescu susține că decizia agenției Fitch de a reconfirma ratingul de țară al României este justificată de evoluția principalilor indicatori macroeconomici. Într-o postare publicată pe site-ul său, acesta a invocat reducerea deficitului bugetar, perspectiva de scădere a inflației, estimările privind revenirea creșterii economice, nivelul rezervelor internaționale și soliditatea sistemului bancar drept principalele argumente care au stat la baza evaluării agenției de rating.

lithuania.title: Un soldat rus a deschis focul asupra camarazilor săi şi a unor civili în Crimeea. „Tragedie la Sevastopol”
lithuania.description: Un soldat rus a deschis focul asupra unor camarazi şi a unor civili în districtul Sevastopol din peninsula ucraineană Crimeea, anexată ilegal de Rusia, ucigând cel puţin patru persoane şi rănind alte patru, a anunţat marți guvernatorul local.

lithuania.title: „Măsuri care nu o să vă placă”: Un fost ambasador al SUA afirmă că NATO ar trebui să avertizeze Moscova cu privire la incursiunile ruse
lithuania.description: NATO ar trebui să avertizeze Moscova că incursiunile rusești continue cu rachete pe teritoriul aliaților ar determina luarea unor măsuri „care nu o să vă placă”, a declarat pentru TVP World fostul ambasador al SUA în Polonia, Daniel Fried. El a adăugat că Varșovia nu trebuie lăsată să răspundă singură unor provocări de acest gen.

lithuania.title: SUA fac încă un pas de retragere din Europa: Americanii nu vor să mai coordoneze ajutorul pentru Ucraina
lithuania.description: Pentagonul renunță la conducerea grupului NATO care coordonează ajutorul militar pentru Ucraina, relatează Politico. Centrul a fost creat chiar la inițiativa americanilor după invazia Rusiei. Publicația notează că decizia face parte din planul administrației Trump de a reduce prezența militară americană în Europa, cum a fost retragerea din România.

lithuania.title: Coaliția Voinței riscă să se destrame după plecarea a doi lideri cheie din funcții. „NATO ar avea o problemă majoră”
lithuania.description: Coaliția Voinței riscă să se destrame pe fondul schimbărilor politice cu care se confruntă Europa. Odată cu plecarea lui Keir Starmer și înlocuirea iminentă a lui Emmanuel Macron, un vid de putere ar putea lăsa blocul comunitar fără direcție. În acest context, oficialii britanici avertizează că „NATO s-ar confrunta cu o problemă majoră”, potrivit The Telegraph.

lithuania.title: Prima reacție a unui ministru german după ce o dronă cu explozibil a pătruns în aeroportul din Leipzig: „Avem măsuri anti-drone, dar au fost ocolite. Vorbim despre un atac hibrid”
lithuania.description: Ministrul german de Interne a avertizat miercuri seară cu privire la „o nouă dimensiune a amenințării”, evocând un posibil „scenariu de atac hibrid” după descoperirea unei drone explozive pe aeroportul din Leipzig, un nod logistic cheie pentru NATO și pentru transportul de echipamente militare și civile către Ucraina, țară pe care Berlinul o susține activ …

lithuania.title: Escaladare fără precedent în Europa: pe aeroportul din Leipzig, Germania, a pătruns o dronă folosită de Rusia în Ucraina, încărcată cu explozibil Semtex / Tot acolo, un avion DHL s-a ciocnit de ceva

lithuania.title: Ukraina registreeris juulis üle pika aja suurima tsiviilohvrite arvu
lithuania.description: Juulis oli Ukrainas alates 2022. aasta aprillist suurim tsiviilohvrite arv Venemaa rünnakute intensiivistumise tõttu, milles kasutati ballistilisi rakette ja kaugmaadroone, edastas neljapäeval uudisteagentuur Ukrinform.

lithuania.description: Ühendriikide ja Ukraina vahelised luureandmete jagamise suhted on alates 2025. aasta märtsist märkimisväärselt paranenud, kirjutas kolmapäeval USA mõjukas poliitikaväljaanne Politico, mida vahendas uudisteagentuur Unian.
